title: Design canvas decision
description: The verdict on the set, what the person marked on each frame, and every comment pinned to a point of a frame.

verdict.description: approve: the designs can go ahead; any comments are remarks. request_changes: revise the frames marked changes and the ones with comments, and send the next round with --revises.

favorite.description: With variants: the group the person starred as the one to go on with. Absent when they starred none.

frames.description: Every frame, in the order sent, with what the person marked on it.

status.description: approved: this frame is done. changes: this frame needs work. unmarked: the person did not say.

comments.description: Each comment, by frame in the order sent, then by when it was written.

frame.description: The id of the frame the comment is on.

x.description: Where the pin is, across the frame: 0 is the left edge, 1 the right.

y.description: Where the pin is, down the frame: 0 is the top, 1 the bottom.

selector.description: For an HTML frame: the CSS selector of the element under the pin, relative to <body> and unique in the document.

snippet.description: The element's text, to find it again if the markup moved.
